title: Good, Bad, Clever
label: ch:mr-good-and-bad
canDo: I can judge a thing good or bad, call a person clever, and deny any of those judgements.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R51-good-and-bad and make three judgements plus a denial -- the tea is good, the water is bad, my friend is clever, the water is not good.
payoff.note: baraM has been in the book since chapter 4 and can only say a STATE is fine; chaanglaa is the first word that judges a thing.
